awakening.title: The awakening
text: You wake up in a dark room.
The floor is cold. The air smells of dust and old paper.
Where are you?
Who are you?
awakening.name: Your name… it comes back to you:

lookAround.title: Nowhere
text: Your eyes adjust to the dark. Books, from floor to ceiling, as far as the eye can see.
Your left hand is clutching two books: a strange notebook bearing your name, and a white book.
Where did they come from?

whiteBook.title: The white book
text: A white cover. No title, no name.
Yet your fingers know it, as if they had held it a thousand times.
You open it a crack: tight printed lines, in signs you cannot read.
And yet you are sure of it: these words are yours.

firstBook.title: The voice
text: You look up from the white book. Nothing has changed: the shadows, the silence, the shelves that never end.
Then a voice. In your head. It isn't yours… or perhaps it is.
“What is the meaning of all this?”
Without knowing why, your hand reaches for the nearest shelf. It closes on a book.

firstKnowledge.title: A sentence
text: In the middle of the gibberish, something catches your eye. A sentence. A real one. You understand it.
“The mind skips every other word.” What if it were true? You could read much faster.
Something lights up inside you: your first Knowledge.
Against your side, the white book has changed. One of its pages has written itself. These words are yours.

firstBookKept.title: The first
text: You close the book. Four hundred and ten pages. Not a single word you understood.
Your hand stops above the shelf. Strangely, you don't feel like putting it back.
It is the first. There will never be another like it.
Something weighs in your pocket. A small brass key. You didn't have it a moment ago.

strangeBook.title: The Ledger
text: This one is not like the others. Black leather, and on the spine, signs you cannot read.
Inside, columns of figures. As if someone were keeping accounts.
Whose accounts?
A few signs seem almost familiar, like a word on the tip of your tongue. The more you understand the Library, the more it will speak to you.

away.title: A dream
text: You open your eyes again. A dream withdraws, slowly, the way ink fades on a page read too often.
For a moment, you thought you were somewhere else.
But no. The dust, the low light, the shelves that never end.
You are still here, searching for what escapes you.
away.while: During this dream ({time}), your hands kept going:
away.capped: Only the first eight hours count.
